statusDefinitions.DONE_PROVEN: Requirement exists and has direct implementation/evidence.

statusDefinitions.PARTIAL_CANDIDATE: Implemented or improved on an unpromoted candidate branch but still not fully complete.
statusDefinitions.DEFERRED_SERVICE: Connected/backend functionality is intentionally deferred, but truthful preview/layout work may still be required.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED_CONTENT_ENDPOINT: Implementation depends on approved content or a real endpoint; structure can still be prepared without fabricating it.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED_APPROVED_COPY: Cannot publish final legal/content copy until approved source text exists.

operatingRules: No task may be called priority work unless it advances at least one explicit manifest page row, cross-cutting requirement, or real release blocker.
Automated QA proves implementation health, not manifest completion or visual acceptance.
A passed work order never cancels an unimplemented manifest requirement.
Home remains incomplete until LOCK_VISUAL is judged against the approved Home image and owner acceptance is recorded.
Do not spend Arcade/gameplay re-certification effort unless a website integration change plausibly changed the qualified game behavior.
Historical project folders are donors/evidence only unless cited by current authority.
Percentages must name their denominator: live shell, current candidate, or full 30-page manifest.
Connected services and unpublished content must remain truthful rather than fabricated.
